title: Remediator Flush + Chino, Greens
last_load: Run clean water through the boom first
site_check: Spray signs out on every green and the nursery. Not the CPG or the Himalayan
weather: Delta T 2–8 · wind under 15 km/h · dew off · finished well before the rain at midday
extra_checks: Clean water run through the boom first
Bucket test: one nozzle for 1 minute at 3.8 bar
600 L/ha at 4.7 km/h needs about 3.5 L/min on 75 cm nozzle spacing (2.35 L/min on 50 cm). If it's out, call Andy before you fill
Dew off the greens before you spray

products.why: The label says Companion goes in first, before anything else. There's no copper in this tank, so its copper restraint is clear.

ppe_note: Remediator has no label or SDS on file, so mix it in the full kit: goggles, elbow gloves and apron. Chino: overalls and elbow-length chemical gloves.
spray_rules: Dew off the greens first. Delta T was 0.4 at dawn, nothing will dry on wet leaf
Greens only: all course greens, then the nursery. Not the CPG or the Himalayan, and nothing around the greens
Be finished well before the rain at midday. Gusts reach 23 km/h by 10am and 32 by noon: stop if it's blowing off target
Water in straight after with the greens wash-in program (#24). The 4th and the nursery get theirs by hand
Stroke Medal is off the 1st and 10th from 8:15am. Stay ahead of both tees, never spray a green with golfers on or near it, and keep people off each green until it's watered in
spray_more: Chino 400 SC (cyazofamid, Group 21): 1.0 L/ha in 400–500 L/ha, spray before disease shows, consecutive sprays about 21 days apart, lightly water in for Pythium root rot. Cyazofamid labels: medium droplets or coarser, wind 3–20 km/h, no spraying in an inversion, 5 m no-spray zone downwind of water.
post_checks: Greens wash-in program (#24) run straight after
4th green and the nursery watered in by hand

flags.t: Remediator: no label or SDS on file
flags.d: Turf Data lists Remediator as an unverified flush product with no ingredient record in GreenKeeper, and I couldn't find a label or SDS online. The page treats it as hazardous (goggles, elbow gloves, apron when mixing) and puts a 'drum label read' tick on the rig checklist.

flags.t: Water-in: #24 set to 1.2–2.0 mm a head
flags.d: Shaped per head off the moisture map's 8am forecast against the course mean (20.6%), capped at 2 mm. Driest heads get 2 mm (9G2_1 at 13.1%, 7:30), wettest 1.2 mm (14G2, 5G6, 10G4). Average 1.5 mm, longest head 7:30, 515 head-minutes. The 8th's part-circle heads run 1:29–2:25. The 4th (Lynx, 9.7–10.2% forecast) and the nursery aren't in it.
flags.s: Moisture map 4 Nov 8am forecast · Cirrus Pro #24

flags.d: Label rate is 1.0 L/ha in 400–500 L/ha; the sheet runs 600 L/ha. The label's light water-in for root Pythium is covered by the #24 wash-in.
flags.s: Chino 400 SC product page · cyazofamid 400 SC label

flags.d: Dry until midday, then about 6.8 mm 12–6pm (heaviest 2–5pm) and 8.5 mm to midnight. Gusts 23 km/h by 10am, 32 at noon, 40 by 2pm.

flags.t: Second greens spray card on the board
flags.d: The board also has 'Apply Fungicide to Green Complexes' (Nathan F, no notes). If that card is this tank's Chino, close it with this one.

flags.t: Nozzles: white at 3.8 bar adds up on 75 cm
flags.d: White is ISO size 08: about 3.56 L/min at 3.8 bar. At 4.7 km/h that's about 606 L/ha on 75 cm nozzle spacing. The bucket test on the rig checklist confirms it.
